purpose: Generated transparent research-station and survey-ship assets for the monitoring animation.

prompts.station:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG sprite for the central hub of a dark sci-fi research-map UI, shown about 140 pixels wide.
Primary request: a beautiful, clearly recognizable science-fiction orbital research space station.
Subject: a compact architectural station, a substantial hexagonal central science hub surrounded by modular laboratories and four chunky docking arms, antenna dishes and short solar-array wings. Clearly a space station, a built facility rather than a spacecraft or an atomic symbol.
Style/medium: premium detailed 3D game render, believable hard-surface engineering with a readable chunky silhouette, near top-down three-quarter orthographic view.
Composition: one isolated object centered, entire station visible with generous transparent margin, roughly square footprint. Strong shape readable at small size.
Lighting and palette: pearl-grey and dark gunmetal metal, restrained bronze details, small warm amber windows and cyan scientific instrument lights; soft light from upper left, enough contrast for a nearly black backdrop.
Constraints: genuine transparent background. No planet, starfield, backdrop, ground, cast shadow, text, logo, watermark, border, orbit lines or atomic-electron rings. No weapons. No other objects.
prompts.ship:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG research spaceship sprite for a dark sci-fi map animation, displayed 22 pixels wide.
Primary request: one small science-fiction research spacecraft that is recognizable as a real ship at tiny size.
Subject: a compact survey vessel with a blunt faceted cockpit at the RIGHT, a broad pearl-grey central body, two distinct rear engine nacelles at the LEFT, small scientific sensor pods and short wing panels. A small chunky exploration ship, not a fighter, arrow or triangle.
Style/medium: premium 3D game sprite, simple readable hard-surface silhouette, near top-down orthographic view. Same believable pearl-grey and gunmetal materials, restrained bronze details, warm amber cabin light and tiny cyan engine lights as a research space station.
Composition: ONE isolated spacecraft, horizontal with nose pointing precisely RIGHT and engines LEFT, fully visible and centered. Ship occupies about 80% of image width and 40% of height with empty transparent margin. No perspective foreshortening along travel axis.
Lighting: soft upper-left illumination, bright enough to read on a nearly black background.
Constraints: genuine transparent background. No space scene, background, shadow, trails, plume beyond the body, text, logos, border, weapons, planets or additional craft.
